No — that is made up
games.why: Yes, this is true. In 1960 the physicist Heinz von Foerster and two colleagues at the University of Illinois published a paper in Science called “Doomsday: Friday, 13 November, A.D. 2026”. Looking at 2,000 years of population estimates, they saw the world’s population doubling faster and faster, and worked out that if the trend carried on, the curve would reach infinity on that date. It did not happen because growth slowed down: from the 1960s families around the world began having fewer children, and the UN now expects the population to peak at about 10.3 billion in the 2080s.
